title: Oct 15 beta build 1.60.1.70425: development notes
claim: Blizzard deployed beta build 1.60.1.70425 on Oct 15 (maintenance from 1:15 p.m. PDT) and posted its development notes the same evening: racial reworks, wand/Auto Shot stand-still, class retunes for every class, Wetlands respawn increases and quest fixes in Ashenvale, Darkshore, Stormwind, Teldrassil, Mulgore, Dalaran and Zephras Isle.
detail: The notes are post 6 of the dev-notes thread (US) and of the EU thread 631316. Leveling-relevant parts are split into their own notes from 2026-10-17 (racials, wands/Auto Shot, Wetlands respawns, quest fixes, Dalaran for Horde, Mage, Shaman, Priest, Paladin, Druid, Warlock, Hunter, Warrior). Other changes: creatures regenerate health properly out of combat; scrolls trigger the global cooldown; Draught of Predatory Senses is now a Potion on the combat-potion cooldown with a shorter duration; Looking For Group updates dungeon eligibility for mixed-level parties; level-up stat/talent messages are back; /who searches subzones; the 'refresh world' prompt can't be accepted in combat; Legacy Bartering no longer discounts training and repairs; Battleground Marks stack to 30. A smaller client build 70450 followed (cosmetics only, n:20261017-client-build-70450).

title: Wands and Auto Shot need 0.5 s standing still before firing
claim: Since the Oct 15 build, wands and Hunter Auto Shot require the character to stand still for 0.5 seconds before they shoot (as in early WoW); Auto Shot still fires while casting Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot.
detail: Every wanding caster (Priest, Mage, Warlock) loses time if they move and shoot; Hunters can't shoot on the move. A bug-tracker issue that called the Auto Shot cast time a bug was closed Not A Bug on Oct 17 (#385) citing these notes; a macro trick that removed the delay (#361) is reported as hotfixed. New option: Auto Attack/Auto Shot switches automatically for Hunters. Melee swings still reset the Hunter's ranged timer (#14, open bug). Supersedes the Oct 9 note about a 0.1-0.2 s Auto Shot cast.

title: Auto Shot still has a 0.1-0.2 s cast; ranged code being reworked
claim: Auto Shot still has a 0.1-0.2 s cast time (Throw 0.5 s); Blizzard (Zirene) calls it a known issue and says ranged code is being reworked.
detail: Superseded on 2026-10-17: the Oct 15 build made Auto Shot and wands require 0.5 s standing still (n:20261017-wand-autoshot-stand-still). Melee swings also put Warrior ranged attacks on cooldown (issue #14).

title: Racials reworked (Oct 15): weapon racials become crit, Blood Fury 3 min, Troll regen 20%
claim: Oct 15 build: Human Sword Specialization -> Ruthless (+2% crit, any weapon); Orc Axe Specialization -> Savage (+1% crit), Blood Fury cooldown 3 min (was 2); Dwarf Mace Specialization -> Earth Fury (+2% crit damage and healing); Tauren Endurance -> +2% crit damage/healing (was +1% hit), Plainsrunning adds +3% mounted speed, War Stomp 90 s, Cultivation 15 min; Troll Regeneration +20% (was 10%); Skyborne Wind Blessed 3% haste (was 1%), Walk on Air 90 s; Night Elf Quickness stacks with other speed increases; Gnome Eureka! is an 8 s buff; Undead Touch of the Dead procs 30% (casters) / 20% (Paladin, Rogue, Warrior) with a 25 s internal cooldown.
detail: Leveling effect: Human and Orc crit no longer depends on the weapon, so any class benefits (casters included). Dwarf Find Treasure now also finds extra items in most chests; Skyborne Elemental Convergences and Leylines spawn in more places. Plainsrunning needs a minimum distance per second (no stutter-stepping). Bug report after the build: Undead Touch of the Grave misses almost every time against level-appropriate mobs, as if cast at level 1 (#369, designer asked whether it still happens, Oct 16). Berserking was not changed despite Aggrend's Oct 8 remarks.

title: Blood Fury and Berserking may be nerfed; weapon-skill racials may change in next week's build
claim: Aggrend said on the WoW: Forever podcast that Orc Blood Fury and Troll Berserking are 'perhaps a little too strong' and may be nerfed, and that the weapon-skill/crit racials could be kept, replaced or removed, with changes expected in next week's beta build.
detail: Superseded on 2026-10-17 by the Oct 15 racial changes (n:20261017-racials-oct15): Blood Fury cooldown 3 min, weapon racials replaced by crit; Berserking unchanged.

title: Wetlands: faster, evened-out respawns (Dragonmaw, gnolls, Incendicite Ore)
claim: The Oct 15 build increased and evened out respawn rates in several Wetlands areas, including Dragonmaw Orcs, Gnolls and Incendicite Ore.
detail: Helps the Wetlands kill and collect quests (Dragonmaw camps, Mosshide gnolls, Incendicite Mine) at roughly levels 20-30. No timers given; treat the old crowded-camp waits as shorter.

title: Oct 15 quest fixes: The Attack! shareable, Darkshore furbolg credit, Raene's Cleansing, Lord Melenas
claim: Oct 15 build: Stormwind 'The Attack!' is no longer an escort and can be shared, even while the event runs (talk to Tyrion to start it); Darkshore furbolg camps now all give credit for 'How Big a Threat?'; 'For Love Eternal' can be turned in to Cerellian Whiteclaw at any time; 'Body and Heart' no longer uses up the Cenarion Moondust; Ashenvale has more Bloodtooth Guards for 'Raene's Cleansing'; Teldrassil's Lord Melenas no longer evades at low health ('Twisted Hatred').
detail: Also: several multi-drop quest items that should not have been were fixed; Mulgore Novice Warriors no longer flag you for PvP in 'Sparring Match'; Zephras Isle 'The Anchors of Zephras' was unblocked (Halaan's Gift can scry the anchors again). Druid Cat Form quest: a Beta hotfix on Oct 16 lets druids loot the relics again (n:20261017-druid-cat-form-quest-hotfix).

title: Druid Cat Form quest: relic looting fixed by Beta hotfix (Oct 16)
claim: Kaivax said on Oct 16 that a Beta hotfix fixed the bug that stopped druids from looting the relics needed for the Cat Form quest.
detail: Cat Form is a quest reward in Forever; until the fix the quest could not be finished (forever-bugs #362 'still bugged' on Oct 16 morning).

title: Dalaran is hostile to the Horde; Sewer Key quest no longer opens the city
claim: Oct 15 build: Horde players are attacked on sight in Dalaran, and the Horde questline for the Dalaran Sewer Key no longer grants open-world access to the city; access to the City of Dalaran dungeon is unchanged.
detail: Datamined companion aura 'Being Watched' (70425): 'You are tolerated, but not welcome. Linger too long on the streets of the city and you will be expelled forcefully.' Horde routes must not path through Dalaran's streets; go straight to the dungeon entrance.

title: Dalaran -> Stormwind portal: Skyborne-only, and reported missing since Oct 15
claim: The portals between Dalaran's Sky Enclave and Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum are reported to be Skyborne-only (Factoruide, Oct 14), and since the Oct 15 build Alliance Skyborne report the Dalaran -> Stormwind portal missing entirely (forever-bugs #380, two reporters).
detail: Effect if it stays: Alliance Skyborne leave Zephras Isle at about level 14 and arrive near Dalaran, then have to cross Alterac/Hillsbrad past level ~26 mobs to reach Southshore and the boats, instead of porting to Stormwind (Westfall/Redridge). Horde Skyborne are reported to go to Mulgore instead. No Blizzard reply yet; not in the Oct 15 notes. Other Alliance races reach Dalaran (City of Dalaran dungeon, 28-33) over land.

title: Mage: new Frost Blast at 24 (40% slow), Ice Lance 200% vs frozen, Cone of Cold buffed on up to 4 targets
claim: Oct 15 build: Mages learn Frost Blast at level 24 (rank 1: 26 Frost damage, 40% slow for 9 s, 1.5 s cast, 40 mana; ranks 2-3 at 36 and 48: 45/77 damage, 65/90 mana), affected by all Frostbolt talents; Ice Lance vs Frozen targets is +200% (was +300%); Cone of Cold slows the first 4 targets an extra 10% for 3 s longer.
detail: Blizzard: Frost Blast gives back what rank-1 Frostbolt did for kiting before the downranking penalties. Arcane Blast reworked (1.5 s cast, 15% of Intellect as spell damage per stack, 40% lower coefficients); new 16-point Arcane Wrath; Missile Barrage moved to row 1; Fire: Critical Mass up to 5 points, Fire Power redesigned, Heating Up/Fire Blast changes; Clearcasting no longer rolls per target hit (fewer free Arcane Explosion/Blizzard procs while AoE farming). Rank values from client data (forever-ref 70425).

title: Shaman: Chain Lightning ~35% cheaper, Fire Nova cut, Lava Burst from 30 as a talent
claim: Oct 15 build: Chain Lightning costs about 35% less mana on all four ranks (client data: 225/305/390/485 -> 145/200/250/315); Fire Nova's spell-power coefficient drops 0.214 -> 0.143 with much lower base damage and mana cost (rank 1 95 -> 65 mana); Lava Burst becomes the 21-point Elemental gold-medal talent with rank 1 at level 30 (was 40; ranks now 30/40/50, 135 mana, 114-145 damage per foreverchanges).
detail: Other: Elemental Mastery returns as the 31-point talent (-0.5 s Lightning Bolt/Lava Burst, no Chain Lightning cooldown for 15 s, 3 min CD); Stormstrike costs 8% of base mana (was 125); Water Shield now triggers from any spell crit; Mana Tide Totem has a rank at 38; Grace of Air no longer exclusive with Windfury/Flametongue Totem; totems Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue are raid-wide; Totemic Recall trainer cost fixed to 22s. Fire Nova AoE pulls are weaker for leveling; Chain Lightning pulls are cheaper. Bug report: Elemental Reach no longer extends Flame Shock range (#370).

title: Priest: Devouring Plague 24 s CD, Vampiric Embrace 30 s, Improved Mind Flay ramps
claim: Oct 15 build: Devouring Plague cooldown 24 s (was 60), Shadow Word: Death cooldown 18 s, Vampiric Embrace cooldown 30 s and can't be resisted, Improved Mind Flay makes each tick 10/20% stronger than the last, new row-4 Dark Inspiration (+3-15% Spirit for the party for 10 s after Mind Blast or a full Mind Flay), Mental Strength moves to row 2 (+2-10% Intellect).
detail: Dev notes give SW:D 'was 12 s'; the client data says 15 -> 18 s. Improved Fade and Shadow Infinity removed; Improved Mind Blast moves to row 2; Devouring Contagion spreads to 2 targets; Twin Disciplines now boosts SW:D, Mind Flay, Starshards and Penance; Power in Light boosts Smite/Penance on targets with Holy Fire or SW:P. Bug reports after the build: Dark Inspiration used base Spirit (#372, designer: fixed in a future build); Power Word: Shield can't be refreshed at equal strength (#44, #379).

title: Paladin: Consecration coefficient cut to 0.042, Seal of Righteousness spell-damage bug fixed
claim: Oct 15 build: Consecration's spell-power coefficient per tick drops to 0.042 (was 0.095), Seal of Righteousness no longer gets almost twice its intended benefit from spell damage, Judgement of Righteousness/Fury coefficients corrected, Seal of Fury rank 3 moves to level 26 (was 25), Retribution's Champion of the Light gives 10/20/30% of Intellect as spell damage (was 20/40/60%).
detail: Net nerf to spell-power Paladin leveling and AoE (Consecration) pulls. Also: Righteous Fury Holy threat 90% (was 60%); Protection Shield Specialization restores 4% mana (was 6%); Reckoning stacks up to 4 charges; Blessing of Salvation replaced by Salvation/Mass Salvation (not exclusive with blessings) plus Revoke.

title: Druid: Shred at 20 (was 22), Furor keeps Cat energy into Bear
claim: Oct 15 build: Shred rank 1 is learned at level 20 (was 22); Furor keeps your Cat Form energy when you shift into Bear or Dire Bear Form; Faerie Fire in bear forms now generates threat; Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack only add crit and are raid-wide.
detail: Fixes: Heart of the Wild, Feral Swiftness, Thick Hide and Leader of the Pack apply correctly at login; Omen of Clarity no longer procs from Faerie Fire in feral forms; multiple Insect Swarms no longer stack the hit reduction. Unannounced client change: spell 24867 'Feral Swiftness' (learned at 8) now says 15% Cat Form speed (was 30%); the talent 17002 still says 30%, so this may be a baseline/rank change (n:20261017-feral-swiftness-24867-15pct).

title: Datamined: level-8 'Feral Swiftness' (24867) Cat Form speed 30% -> 15%
claim: In client build 70425, spell 24867 'Feral Swiftness' (learn level 8) changed its text from +30% to +15% movement speed in Cat Form; the Feral Swiftness talent (17002) still reads +30% and +4% dodge.
detail: Not in the Oct 15 notes. Unclear whether 24867 is a baseline passive or the talent's effect; check Cat Form run speed in game before changing travel estimates for Druids.

title: Warlock: Shadow Mastery doubled to 2-10%, Malediction -> Grim Reach, Soul Link fix
claim: Oct 15 build: Shadow Mastery increases Shadow damage by 2/4/6/8/10% (was 1-5%); Malediction is replaced by Grim Reach (+10/20% Affliction range); Destructive Reach is +10/20% Destruction range; Soul Link can be cast on your pet again.
detail: Client data (not in the notes): Amplify Curse boosts Curse of Exhaustion by 50% (was 20%) per foreverchanges, and Portal of Summoning costs 100% of base mana with a 1 h cooldown (was 12%, 2 min). Designer: Amplify Curse with Curse of Exhaustion and Bane of Agony fixed in a future build (#359, #340). Warlock pet crit stays low until pets' baseline crit is removed (#331, designer, Oct 14).

title: Hunter: pets use higher of melee/ranged crit, traps scale with AP, Multi-Shot instant
claim: Oct 15 build: pets inherit the higher of the Hunter's melee or ranged crit (was melee only), Fire Traps scale with attack power (players measure about 13.2% of AP added to Immolation Trap), one Fire and one Ice trap can be active together, Resourcefulness procs only from melee/ranged ability crits, and pet abilities Dismember, Sonic Blast and Mine! are weaker; client data also makes Multi-Shot instant (was 0.5 s cast).
detail: Pet nerfs: Dismember 25% healing reduction/6 s/15 s CD (was 50%/10 s/6 s); Sonic Blast 30%/20 s/60 s CD (was 60%/30 s/30 s); Mine! 3 s/90 s CD (was 4 s/60 s). Trueshot Aura raid-wide; Summon Hawk sticks to the target; Improved Mend Pet cost fixed. Auto Shot stand-still: n:20261017-wand-autoshot-stand-still. Trap AP figure is a combat-log fit by one player (#283), Multi-Shot from foreverchanges/forever-ref.

title: Warrior: Overpower works on much lower-level mobs, Slam no pushback; stance bars bugged
claim: Oct 15 build: Overpower now activates against significantly lower-level enemies, Slam is no longer subject to spell pushback, Lingering Rage no longer stops health regeneration after combat, Improved Berserker Rage removes movement impairing effects, Battle Shout is raid-wide.
detail: Bug after the build: action-bar paging on stance changes is broken for Warriors (and Rogue stealth) (#356, #368; open, no designer reply). Players complain Arms rage is still poor ('STILL no Arms buffs?' thread) - no change announced.

title: Eight starter-zone white drops are now green with +1/+2 stats
claim: In the Oct 15 build, starter-zone white drops became Uncommon (BoE) with a small stat: Ice-covered Bracers (+1 Agi), Royal Frostmane Girdle (+2 Int), Wendigo Fur Cloak (+1 Str), Wispy Cloak (+1 Spi, req. level 5), Ghostly Bracers (+1 Int), Ratty Old Belt (+2 Str), Lithe Boots (+2 Sta), Fingerless Gloves (+2 Agi).
detail: Mostly Elwynn Forest and Dun Morogh, some Tirisfal Glades; required levels 3-8. foreverchanges counts nine such items. Minor gearing help for levels 5-10; more may follow.

title: Desolace: new Gelkis/Magram quest chain now requires level 35
claim: The new Gelkis and Magram quests in Desolace that start with "Valley of Bones" now require level 35 (was 30); a coming hotfix makes their 16 rewards require level 35 to equip.
detail: Affects post-beta routes (cap is 30 in beta): the chain can't be picked up at 30-34. Client build 70425 confirms the reward change: 16 centaur items now require level 35, and 12 of them drop to item level 38 or 42 (was 43) (foreverchanges).

title: Mob health is higher than Era at higher levels, and Blizzard closed it as intended
claim: Forever mobs have more health than Era (and SoD) at higher levels, e.g. a level 46 Highborne Lichling has 3.2k HP (2.8k on SoD) and King Bangalash over 7k (5.5k on Era); a Blizzard designer (AidanZMoon) closed the bug report as not planned / Not A Bug on Oct 15.
detail: Closed without a comment, so the exact scaling is unknown. For the knowledge base: kill time per mob at 40+ is longer than Era-based estimates; Era HP tables underestimate. Source thread on r/classicwow 'Forever mob scaling greater than SoD'.

title: After the Oct 15 build, Resurrection Sickness is 1 minute at every level from 10
claim: Since build 70425, spirit-healer Resurrection Sickness lasts 1 minute for characters level 10 and higher (tested up to level 30, tooltip says 60 s), instead of the Era scaling (none at 10, +1 min per level, 10 min from 20).
detail: Two independent reports (forever-bugs #25 comment, #363 at level 30); the tracker treats it as a bug introduced by the fix for #25. No designer comment yet. Until it changes, the spirit healer is cheap in time (1 min + 25% durability, n:20261011-spirit-healer-durability-25) at every level; it may be corrected before launch.

title: Beta: spirit-healer Resurrection Sickness is the full 10 minutes from level 10
claim: Taking the spirit healer in the beta gave the full 10-minute Resurrection Sickness from level 10 (Era: 1 min at level 10, +1 min per level, 10 min from level 20); Blizzard listed 'duration is not correct at lower levels' as a known issue.
detail: Superseded on 2026-10-17: since build 70425 the sickness is 1 minute at every level from 10 (n:20261017-res-sickness-1min-after-70425).

title: Stress test moved to Oct 21; the beta goes offline during it
claim: Blizzard moved the open WoW Forever stress test to Oct 21 (2 p.m. PDT Americas/Oceania, 19:00 CEST EU, Oct 22 5-6 a.m. Taipei/Korea): any account can join, the beta goes offline, Forever runs for a few hours on the launch hardware, then all stress-test characters are deleted and the beta reopens.
detail: Replaces the Oct 19 date. Blizzard did not state the beta end date or a level cap for the test; launch is still Nov 4 per earlier announcements. Expect crowded starting zones during the test (a preview of launch tagging).

title: Open beta stress test on Oct 19
claim: A 'WoW: Forever - Stress Test' entry in the Battle.net launcher was to open on Oct 19 for accounts without beta access, for several hours.
detail: Superseded on 2026-10-17: moved to Oct 21 (n:20261017-stress-test-oct21).

title: Client build 70450: cosmetics only (mounts, pets, Adventurer's Tent skin)
claim: Beta client build 1.60.1.70450 adds 22 spells and 23 items, all cosmetic (Spectral Wolf Pack, Verdant Sea Turtle and Crimson Rooster mounts at 60, pets, transmog ensembles, an Adventurer's Tent camp skin) and changes no existing spell, item or recipe compared with 70425.
detail: Kaivax (Oct 16): the datamined art assets are not meant for the current version of WoW Forever. No leveling impact.

title: Camp Tent tops rested XP up to 5% of a level, once per hour
claim: Client data: Camp Tent (spell 1307230) lets you and others sitting nearby raise Rested XP to 5% of a level, with no effect if you already have more; it needs a Campfire nearby, triggers after 30 s of resting (1229487), and Boosted Rest (1229451) blocks another tent gain for 1 h.
detail: Confirmed unchanged in builds 70425 and 70450 by a second client-data extract (forever-ref). So a tent is a small top-up (5% of a level per hour), not a big rested source; Well Rested (n:20261009-legacy-perk-numbers) raises rested gain and cap by 20%. All camp features share one 1 h cooldown. Sewing Machine and Tanning Rack give all Camp Tent benefits. (70425 removed the Tent line from the 'Camp Benefits' summary aura's text only.) Not yet confirmed in game.

title: Cooked teas and smoothies give mana plus +5% kill XP well-fed
claim: Forever's new Cooking drinks (Peace/Royal/Root/Triage Tea, Venomous/Slimy Smoothie, Mrrggl Smrrthle, Calcified Smoothie, Goldthorn Tea) restore mana and, after 10 s of drinking, give a 15-minute well-fed buff with Spirit or healing power and +5% XP from kills.
detail: Client data (70450): required levels 1/5/15/25 (cooking 30-45, 105-125, 135-185, 180-235). Recipes sold by Azeroth Commerce Authority vendors (Warcraft Tavern). For casters this means drinking and the kill-XP buff come in one step; the buff is the same +5% as cooked food (n:20261009-crafted-food-5pct-kill-xp), so they likely don't stack.

title: No protection for low-level players on PvP servers
claim: Aggrend said on the WoW: Forever podcast (episode 4) that Blizzard has no plans to protect lower-level players from higher-level ones on PvP realms ('The short answer is: no').
detail: Leveling on a PvP realm keeps Classic ganking risk; contested zones (Stranglethorn, Hillsbrad, Tarren Mill/Southshore) will cost time at launch.

title: World Refresh (layer switch) can drop you into a farmed-out layer mid-quest
claim: The beta's World Refresh moves players to another layer every few minutes (one player reports every 3-5 min) and whenever they invite, join or leave a group; a player reports landing in a layer with three times the players and the quest mobs already killed.
detail: Oct 15 build: the 'refresh world' prompt can no longer be accepted in combat (dev notes). Icy Veins reported in September that a group invite forces a layer change for the whole group. For the coach: group up before reaching a kill/collect area, not at it, and expect a refresh to cost a respawn cycle. Blizzard has not said how launch layering works ('So what is blizzard doing with layering?' thread, Oct 16, no staff reply).

title: Polestar: free open-source Forever guide addon with simulated 1-60 routes
claim: Polestar (fitzforge/polestar, v0.2.5 Oct 17, CurseForge 'polestar-guides', ~100 GitHub stars in 4 days) ships step-by-step 1-60 routes for every race start, chosen by simulating millions of routes per start; its model estimates 117-121 /played hours to 60 solo.
detail: The hours are model estimates, not measurements: it uses the Classic kill-XP formula (45+5*level, elites x2), the client QuestXP table with difficulty tiers, run speed 7 yd/s, grinding weighted 2.5x and 7.5 min per zone change; Forever's 30-60 zones aren't in its data yet. Has a recorder module, group and profession steps and a Discord. Large data: addon/Polestar_Guides/Guides.lua (6 MB), guides/forever/, tools/planner, docs/SIMULATION.md. Useful cross-check for Glide's route ranking.

title: Everloot: crowdsourced Forever drop rates, spawns and trainers (published at 3+ reports)
claim: Everloot (CDVolvik/everloot, everloot.app) is an addon plus site that publishes anonymous in-game observations (drops, vendors, recipes, trainers, prices) as facts once at least three installs report them, under CC BY-SA 4.0, with MCP endpoints for AI assistants.
detail: New on Oct 17 (beta, addon 0.2.6). Could later supply measured quest-item drop rates and spawn points for Glide's kill-count estimates. Needs an adapter; check its data release format.
